summary: Full backend + frontend testing of CS Chatroom. 18/18 pytest tests pass (REST + Socket.IO public rooms + Random Stranger flows). Playwright UI tests pass for: landing hero, nickname validation, chat sidebar (general + 18 sections + random-stranger), channel switching, message send, presence count, unread badges (bump + clear), mobile hamburger overlay, stranger panel + searching state, logout.
critical_code_review_comments: server.js line 172: `io.emit('message:bump', ...)` broadcasts to ALL connected sockets (not just those NOT in the room). Every connected client receives bump for every public message and relies on client-side filter (`activeRoom !== room`). This is fine functionally but wastes bandwidth at scale; consider `io.except(room).emit(...)` or scoping to non-active listeners.

server.js `stranger:skip` handler: pushes the socket back into the waitingQueue but does not check whether the socket is still connected before pushing. Rare race but harmless because tryMatch skips missing sockets.
db.js uses better-sqlite3 which is synchronous; acceptable for this small workload but blocks the event loop under high concurrency. Not a bug — an FYI.

Frontend Chat.jsx: `getSocket()` is called inside handlers and inside the connection effect; because the effect's dep array is empty and `if (s.connected) onConnect()` runs synchronously, it may attempt initial `room:join` before the auth-based connection is fully open — however works reliably because socket.io queues events until connected. No bug observed in testing.
Landing.jsx maxLength=24 restricts client input, but server truncates to 32. Consistent enforcement is fine.
No rate limiting on `message:send` — potential spam vector. Recommend server-side throttle.
test_credentials: N/A - no accounts. Users pick a nickname per session.
seed_data_creation: Test suite creates TEST_ prefixed messages in public rooms. Not cleaned up (SQLite persistence). If needed, main agent can delete rows WHERE content LIKE 'TEST_%' or content LIKE 'hello TEST_%'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend socket flows and REST endpoints verified against production URL. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_chatroom.py uses python-socketio async client. Run with: `cd /app/backend/tests && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest test_chatroom.py -v`. Note: unread snapshot returns 0 for first-time devices per spec — must establish last_seen first via room:markRead before expecting non-zero counts from getUnreadCount. Live unread badges are driven client-side via message:bump event which works correctly.
verified_flows: GET /api/health → {status:'ok'}
GET /api/rooms → general + 18 sections a..r
GET /api/messages/general → {room, messages:[]} with persisted data
GET /api/messages/<unknown> → 404
GET /api/messages/stranger-<uuid> → 404 (stranger rooms are NOT public)
socket connect at /api/socket.io/ with auth={deviceId, nickname}
presence:snapshot and unread:snapshot
room:join general → returns latest 50 + online count + presence broadcast
room:join unknown → ok:false
message:send in public room → persisted, broadcast to room, message:bump emitted
presence:update broadcast on multi-client join (online >= 2)
message:bump increments client-side unread; room:markRead clears server unread count
First-time device unread snapshot is 0 for all rooms (per spec)
messages:loadOlder returns previous batch after 55 msgs in section-c
stranger:find + stranger:find → both clients receive stranger:matched with same room
stranger message not persisted (GET /api/messages/stranger-<id> → 404)
stranger:skip → partner receives stranger:left reason=skipped
stranger:report → server ack ok:true (row inserted into reports table)
stranger disconnect → partner receives stranger:left reason=disconnected
Landing: hero, 3 feature cards (section-rooms/general/random-stranger), nickname 1-char shows toast, valid nickname navigates to /chat
Chat sidebar: current-nickname, channel-general, 18 channel-section-* rows, random-stranger-btn pinned bottom, logout-btn
Mobile: sidebar hidden initially, hamburger opens overlay, selecting channel closes overlay
Multi-client UI: unread badge appears with count=1 for non-active room, clears on open, header online count updates to 2, messages broadcast between browsers
Logout clears nickname & navigates to /
